speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. To better understand your condition, can you tell me if you have a fever or any recent weight loss?

speaker: Patient
text: No, I haven't had a fever or lost any weight recently. I just feel really tired and struggle to breathe when I try to walk to my car. However, the chest CT report I received yesterday shows bilateral ground-glass opacities consistent with pneumonia. You do not need to order new imaging. Use this result.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pneumonia (bilateral ground-glass opacities). Given the absence of fever and the specific radiographic findings, could you clarify if you have any underlying autoimmune conditions or recent viral infections that might explain the non-bacterial presentation?
